reviews.x: Good product, but after finding the exact product at Walmart for $1.57 a bottle, realize too late, how grossly overpriced it is.

reviews.t: Mousse addict - hard to find in travel size
reviews.x: I use the regular size Tresemme mousse all the time at home, but travel size is hard to find at retail, so I was glad to see this at Amazon.  My hair is fine and fly-away, and the mousse really gives it good body and lift.  Performed well in drizzly Vancouver.  Happy with the purchase.
It was my fault for not reading the size. I guess when I saw how much it was, I did not think I would get the travel size, that you get can get at any store in the dollar bin.

I bought this two pack for my Ireland trip.  Love the small size.  There was plenty for my 12 day trip with some left over.  I do have short hair though.  It worked well on my hair in the damp climate and the smell wasn't very noticable and I'm scent sensitive.

Along with many other reviewers, I did not read closely enough to realize how small these are!  Surely by now both the manufacturer and Amazon must know how disappointed we consumers are.  And it is an Amazon "Best Buy"  VERY disappointed.

reviews.t: Great for travel; not a great product.
reviews.x: These are great for traveling, but I really just do not like this product. It makes my curls very crunchy. :(

Like many others, I did not realize this was travel size, especially since the price seemed reasonable for the full size cans. My fault, but very disappointed in how expensive these were for the size. I do like them for traveling, but can get these much cheaper at the store.
I love Tresemme, unfortunately I did not read the description of fluid oz. Please note that each one holds only 2oz. Good to take with you if you are traveling, but not for home use.

For $8.99, you might assume you are getting two full size bottles, as that's more than you would pay for two at Target, $3.99 each there,  but hey, they are delivering them and you don't have to go out for them, right?  But, no.  They are two small travel sized bottles.  And you can't return them.  So, hey, my bad for not reading the oz and for assuming, which never works out well, but don't let it happen to you!

reviews.t: Not the product I remember from years ago
reviews.x: I used this mousse many years ago and loved it, but this was different; it smelled really strong like rubbing alcohol and it didn't really add any volume to my hair.
I have used this mousse for years but needed a couple travel size which I could not find in any local stores.  So, of course, I could find it on Amazon.
I should have read the description didn’t realize how small these were lol. Tried returning them but couldn’t :/

reviews.t: Make sure you check the product size!!
reviews.x: I always use this mousse, so when I recently was running out during the pandemic shutdown, I asked my son to order this product for me (since he is a Prime member and gets free shipping).  The price of roughly $10 for 2 bottles was a little bit higher than I usually pay for two large bottles, but I figured it was OK. Shame on me for not checking the size more closely before purchasing.  When the two very small bottles arrived, I realized my costly error.  The normal bottle size is 10.5 oz, while

I thought I was getting the "regular" size. My own fault for not looking at the description carefully. But $4 each for this very small container, 2 oz, seems excessive to me, especially since I won't be traveling until there's a vaccine for COVID-19, so it's just for at home use. I like the mousse, it's my go to brand, just bummed that I got the small version. Be more alert than i was if you plan to use this at home.  The same brand in the 10 oz size was $15.67 today for 2 bottles.

Finding travel sizes of mousse it very difficult to find. I know, I travel often and often lost mine at the luggage checkin and had to buy a full size, just to leave it at the hotel when leaving. I asked my hair dresser if she knew and she did not know. A web search led me to Amazon. Not only is it the perfect size but Tresemme is a well known, quality product. I bought two :)

reviews.t: WHAT a RIPOFF. Spent $15 for two TRAVELSIZE!
reviews.x: I am disabled and unable to get out nowadays anyway but needed this product. Placed my order and today when they arrived it was two 2 oz. size, the travel size!  And...it is not eligible for Return! I ordinarily pay $3.99 each and didn't mind the given price for the two, but this is beyond a ripoff. I am so angry right now I can't even tell you.

I've used this product for years now and I normally pay around 5.00 for a large can. This is the tiniest can I've ever seen and it was 13.00! For one can! Insane to me. I was under the impression that it was going to be a pack of 2 regular size and thought it was a great deal but alas it wasn't at all

reviews.t: Travel size. If you want a normal sized bottle, this is not for you.
reviews.x: Nowhere in the very  long item description does it say two very important words-travel size. You find that out when you open a box with two child sized bottles of mousse in it. I would not have paid $10 had I realized this.

reviews.t: It's a trap! BEWARE its 2-2oz. Containers.
reviews.x: $10 for 4 oz. Is not what I expected. The pics dont highlight the small size. It cannot be returned. Dont get fooled like I did. First time leaving a negative response in my many years of being an amazon costumer.

Be aware these are tiny 2 oz travel size cans worth about $2.50 ea. at Walmart or Walgreens. A 10.5 oz can is $5.00 elsewhere. I like the product and use it all the time, but will not buy it again here.
Came in a nice little pack of 3. Great size for traveling so you don’t need to carry a larger can around with you. The cap stays tightly secure on the can ensuring the nozzle won’t get pressed.
tresemme quality now in travel size format.  this mousse leaves hair smelling fresh, helps control hair styles but still leaves hair moveable and soft.  great for frizzy hair and static too.
Had to travel to DC for a meeting, and it is so hard to find travel size necessities.  I found both the Tresemme mousse that I regularly use AND the Tresemme hair spray I use in travel size.
The photo makes the bottles look larger. You can get the same thing in Walmart for $1.79 travel size vs. this at $5.00 each.  This item is also non-returnable...very dissappointed.

reviews.t: These are 2 oz bottles!!!! Read carefully.
reviews.x: This is the 2nd time I ordered this thinking I was ordering 2 regular size bottles of this. Never again. I will go to drug store and pay the same price for 2 regular sized bottles

claims.text: Many reviewers were surprised the product is a small travel size rather than full size, often because they did not read the description closely.
Reviewers frequently complain the price is too high for the small size, noting they could buy it cheaper at stores like Walmart or Target.
Several reviewers value the travel size because it is hard to find in local stores and works well for trips.
Some reviewers report the product performs well on their hair, giving body and lift and holding up in damp climates.
A few reviewers were disappointed with the product itself, citing crunchy curls, strong alcohol-like smell, or lack of volume.
